title: Principal neighborhoods attaining local dimension
statement: For any commutative ring S and prime q∈Spec S [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and any a∈S outside q, there exists b∈S outside q such that Spec(S_(a*b)) [def-weil-ring-localization-away] has topological Krull dimension equal to the local topological dimension at q [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point]. No finite-type or Noetherian hypothesis is required.

source.place: Topology, Definition 0055 (local dimension as the minimum of neighborhood dimensions), used in Algebra 00SC; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0055

proof.text: The dimensions of the open neighborhoods of q take values in well ordered WithBot ENat; ciInf_mem attains their infimum, which is topologicalKrullDimAt q.

Choose a basic open D(b) about q within an attaining open neighborhood. D(a*b)=D(a)∩D(b) is another neighborhood. The inducing inclusion bounds its dimension above by the minimum; the defining infimum bounds it below.
PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_isOpenEmbedding and localization_away_comap_range identify Spec S_(a*b) homeomorphically with D(a*b). IsHomeomorph.topologicalKrullDim_eq gives the asserted equality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_mul_away_dimension_eq
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] (q : PrimeSpectrum S) (a : S) (ha : a ∉ q.asIdeal) :
    ∃ b : S, b ∉ q.asIdeal ∧
      topologicalKrullDim (PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away (a * b))) =
        topologicalKrullDimAt q
